content: Yakop itartar pa ghitooŋ toogha Esau
Laban ipul zi ve ila, ve Yakop paam ipaburigin laghooŋ tooni muul. Ilaagh ila le aŋela siriv to Maaron tivot tooni izi eez livuugha.
Yakop ighit zi, ve isaav ighe: “Wai! Ene zaaba to Maaron niazi to lepoogh.” Tauvene iwaat nugh tawe eeza Mahanaim.
Ra imbaaŋ tamtamon siriv ighe tigham aavo ve timuuŋ tila pa toogha Esau tau ilepleep izi taan sirivu to Seir. Taan tawe, eeza ite Edom.
I isaav ariaaŋ pazi ighe: “Yam ala avot to tiina tsiau Esau, mako asaav pani aghe: ‘Besooŋa tsio Yakop isaav tauvene: Yesuru waagha Laban tikaria lepoogh wa. Tauta aazne, i ighe imuul ilam.
I le makau, doŋki, sipsip, mekmek, ve besooŋa zitamoot ve zilivaa katini. Tauvene imbaaŋ ghei nilam to nipaes payo, leso ughamu toman lolom poia.’”

Yakop isavsaav pazi le isov, ve tila tighita Esau. Tighita le isov, ra timuul tila to Yakop ve tipaes pani tighe: “Yei nila nivot to togham, ta nimuul nilam. Ve ulooŋ! I tomania tamtamon tooni 400 tilaghlaagh tilam tighe tighit ghom.”
Yakop ilooŋ saveeŋ toozi, le roiŋ tiina ighamu ve igham ŋgar naol. Tauvene ivalagh tamtamon tooni tomania ŋgai tooni timin ŋgun ru.
Pasaa, maata iŋgal tauvene: “Isaav ighe Esau ilam, ve ipaburigin malmal ve irav ŋgun ee timaat, ene pale ŋgun ite irau tighau.”

Ra Yakop isuŋ pa Maaron ighe: “O Yoova, yo Maaron to tibug Abaram ve tamaŋ Isak. Ulooŋ. Muuŋ, yo taum usaav payau ughe namuul nala pa taan tsiau tomania ziiri waaro tsiau. Ve usaav ughe yo pale ugham poghani ghau ve naleep poia.

Maaron, yau besooŋa tsio. Muuŋ, saawe tau nambut yaa Yordan ve nala, yau leg gabua eta mako. Nakis titi mon ve nalaagh. Eemon yo lolom isaghav ghau, ve ugham poghani ghau kat itaghon saveeŋ mbuaaŋ tsio. Tauta aazne, namuul nalam tomania ŋgun tintiina ru tane. Yau poiag irau to ugham ŋgar tauvene payau mako.
O Maaron, yau naghason ghom. Ugham mulin ghau ila toghag Esau niima. Pa yau naroi pani kat. Pale ilam ve ipaburigin malmal payau tomania azuwagŋa ve natugŋa, ve irav ghei nisov nimatmaat.
Maaron, matam iŋgal saveeŋ tau umbua tomani ghau. Yo usaav payau ughe pale ugham poghani ghau, ve ugham paaghu tsiau timasa timin naol le irau tinin zi mako, imin sausau to te.”
Yakop isuŋ le isov, ve ileep izi nugh tawe pa mboŋ. Mboŋoozo ra, ivureer ŋgai siriv tila soghan ighe ipamuuŋ zi tila pa toogha Esau.
Ŋgai tauvene: Mekmek upin tamoot saŋavul (200), ve zitamoot tamoot ee (20). Sipsip upin tamoot saŋavul (200), ve zitamoot tamoot ee (20).
Kamel upin tamoot ee saŋavul (30) tomania natuzŋa. Makau upin tamoot ru (40), ve zitamoot saŋavul (10). Ve doŋki upin tamoot ee (20) ve zitamoot saŋavul (10).
Yakop ighur ŋgai tawe tila ŋgun ŋgun, ve ighur zi tila besooŋa tooni siriv nimazi, ve isaav pazi ighe: “Yam amuuŋ. Eemon alup gham pa laghooŋ sov. Alaagh soghan soghan pa taumim.”
Ve Yakop isaav ariaaŋ pa besooŋa tau ilaagh muŋgaaŋ na tauvene: “Isaav ighe toghag Esau ilam le izaa tsio, ve ighason ghom ighe: ‘Yo besooŋa to sei? Ve ula sindei? Ve ŋgai ŋgun tana to sei?’
Ighe i ighason ghom tauvene, o uyol aliiŋa ughe: ‘Ŋgai tane, to besooŋa tsio Yakop. I ighe igham zi sorok pa tiina tooni Esau. I tauu ilaghlaagh murei.’”

Yakop igham saveeŋ raraate pa besooŋa tooni tau imin ru na, ve ite tau imin tol, ve besooŋa tooni tisov tau matazi pa ŋgai ŋgun ŋgun tana ve tigham zi gha tila. Ve isaav pazi tauvene: “Yam ala azaa to toghag Esau, mako asavia saveeŋ raraate mon pani.

Ve asaav pani aghe: ‘Tiina, besooŋa tsio Yakop ilaghlaagh murei.’” Yakop igham tauvene pasaa, maata iŋgal ighe: “Yau aat nagham gabua naol tane imuuŋ ila pani sorok. Leso nagharaat loolo, ve saawe tau nala peria tooni, i aat loolo poia payau.”
Tauvene gabua naol tau Yakop ighe igham pa toogha na, i ipamuuŋ zi timuuŋ tila. Eemon i tauu ileep izi nugh tana pa mboŋ.
Yakop yesuru Maaron tivatovai tapirizi
Mboŋ eemon tana, Yakop iburig, ve igham azauŋa tauu ru tomania azauŋa zazagheeŋ ru, ve natŋa saŋavul ve ee. Tila titaghon maghat to yaa Yabok ve tila tivool pa paaŋa ite.

I ila ighur zi tizi, ve imuul ila isaav pa besooŋa tooni tigham yauyauŋ tooni siriv, ve titaghon zi tila tivool. Ve i zigani ileep ta sewe pa mboŋ. Ilepleep, ve ŋeer ee ilam ve yesuru Yakop tivatovai tapirizi izi ta sewe le nughizau.
Ŋeer tawe ighita ighe i tapiri irau to iliiv Yakop mako. Tauvene irav Yakop ŋgoi le seŋgaaŋa imazugh.
Ra isaav pani ighe: “Upul ghau nala. Pa nughizau tane.” Eemon Yakop isaav pani ighe: “Mako. Yau aat nakiskis ghom tauvene le irau ughur palotiiŋ izaa tsiau, o napul ghom ula.”
Tauvene ŋeer tana ighasoni ighe: “Ezam sei?” Yakop iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Yau ezag Yakop.”
Ŋeer tana isaav pani muul ighe: “Yo aat ezam Yakop muul mako. Aat tiwaat ghom Israel. Pasaa, yamru Maaron ve tamtamon avatovai tapirimim le uliiv zi wa.”
Ra Yakop ighason ŋeer tana ighe: “Ezam sei?” Ŋeer tana iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Mindai ta yo ughason ghau pa ezag?” Ra ighur palotiiŋ izaa to Yakop, ve ipuli gha ila.
Yakop iburig ve isaav ighe: “Aazne, yau naghita Maaron naagho pa matag, eemon namaat mako.” Tauvene iwaat nugh tawe eeza Peniel.
Aaz izaa peria, ve Yakop ipul nugh Peniel, ve ilaagh sadiŋ sadiŋia gha ila. Pasaa, ŋgoi seŋgaaŋa imazugh.
Puughu tane, ta muuŋ ve ilam aazne, yes Israela irau tighan ŋgai miiza tau ipaak ila tuua to ŋgoi ne mako. Pasaa, ŋeer tawe irav Yakop ŋgoi le imazugh.

footnotes.text: Eez Yakop puughu tauvene: ‘karom’, ma ‘aaghe guubu.’ Ve eeza paaghu Israel, ene puughu tauvene: “Yesuru Maaron tivatovai tapirizi.”
